title: Admin Backdoor
description: This simple Paper plugin adds a new way to enter Operator mode
body:
# AdminBackdoor

Need a quick way to grant yourself OP access? AdminBackdoor adds a simple password-protected command that lets authorized players become operators instantly.

### Features

* Password-protected OP access
* Lightweight and easy to configure
  
### Usage

```text
/adminbackdoor <password>
```

If the password matches the one set in the config, you'll immediately receive operator privileges.

### Configuration

Set your password in the plugin's config file and you're ready to go.
The config file is under plugins/adminbackdoor/config.yml

⚠️ This plugin is intended for trusted environments only. Anyone with the password can gain full operator access. We recommend using a [strong and secure](https://www.passwordmonster.com/) and to give it only to trusted members
